key_insight: This review connects reinforcement learning with PDE-constrained optimization to frame adaptive feedback control of complex distributed systems.
engineering_relevance: RL offers a route to efficient real-time PDE control despite high-dimensional states, distributed actuation, and nonlinear dynamics.
method: Unify RL and PDE-constrained optimization perspectives.
Survey model-free, model-based, and multi-agent approaches.
Examine sample efficiency, parameter generalization, and scalability.
evidence_signal: Chaotic-system stabilization and flow-control examples illustrate practical performance and pitfalls; the abstract reports no quantitative benchmarks.
watch_item: Reliable deployment requires careful evaluation of data demands and robustness across operating conditions.
paper_title: Reinforcement learning for control of partial differential equations
